scenes.text: Imagine living in a perfect paradise with zero wind, zero storms, and unlimited water, which is exactly what scientists built in the 1990s inside a massive glass dome called Biosphere 2.
Inside this utopia, the trees grew faster than anywhere else on Earth, but then something bizarre happened as they began to suddenly collapse under their own weight.
Baffled scientists eventually realized that without any wind inside the dome, the trees never experienced the physical stress required to develop the deep, strong wood that keeps them standing.
This proves that the struggles we try to avoid are exactly what keep us upright, so has a difficult challenge in your life ever actually made you stronger? Let me know in the comments.
